verdict.rationale: Probes confirm there is no llms.txt (404) and no markdown docs endpoint (404). The vendor does publish a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.speechischeap.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200) and an official ClawHub agent skill repo, which together give agents a first-party, machine-consumable entry point. Missing for 10: an llms.txt file, markdown/agent-optimized versions of the docs, any explicit docs guidance on pointing agents at the documentation, and independent corroboration of agent use.
